title: ApiError
description: The platform's canonical API error envelope (daml-escrow-commons apierror; TypeScript mirror in @vdatacloud/cx-commons sdk/api-error). Canonical serialization: compact JSON, properties in the order listed, details keys sorted, absent properties omitted. At Summary detail level, details and upstream.cause are omitted.

status.description: HTTP status the error is sent with.

stage.description: The step of a multi-step flow that failed.

hint.description: What to check or do next; long identifiers shortened.

details.description: Full-length values behind shortened identifiers; shape per code (see allOf).

node.description: The instance that answered, e.g. a Canton participant.

expectedHash.description: Transaction hash the participant expected signed (hex).

ledgerUser.description: Ledger API user the request was submitted as.

partyFingerprint.description: The party's namespace: the fingerprint of the only key that can sign for it.

publicKeyFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the key the request presented.

signedBy.description: Key fingerprint the signature was submitted under.

signedMessage.description: What the signature had to cover (nonce, or a base64 multi-hash).
